latest_release.name: v3.2.1
latest_release.body:
Small release with a fix for #1587.

## What's Changed
* doc/vmaf_v1: update Netflix techblog url by @kylophone in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1545
* build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1546
* build(deps): bump actions/cache from 4 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1550
* libvmaf/thread_pool: fix thread pool queue depth to restore backpressure by @kylophone in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1557
* libvmaf/feature: enable speed_chroma/speed_temporal without enable_float by @kylophone in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1558
* .github/ci: fix release asset name collision across build matrix by @kylophone in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1559
* libvmaf/speed_chroma: remove bilinear prescale index/weight computation from per-pixel loop by @kylophone in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1565
* build(deps): bump actions/setup-python from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1569
* cuda: fix row stride in calculate_motion_score_kernel_16bpc (wrong scores for >8-bit input) by @BardieJoensen in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1552
* Fix race condition with generated header under parallel builds by @StormBytePP in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1578
* Add ARM NEON implementation for 8-bit integer motion feature by @kjg0724 in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1570
* AVX512: Drop -mavx512vbmi from generic AVX-512 compile flags by @StormBytePP in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1577
* Add support for Intel CET (SHSTK) by @StormBytePP in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1575

## New Contributors
* @BardieJoensen made their first contribution in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1552
* @kjg0724 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/pull/1570

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Netflix/vmaf/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1
